name: Paisley’s Heart: A Magical Girl Origin Story
source:
Paisley Clark is a normal girl in a world of Nightmares, Magical Girls, and more. Her best friend, Tama, recently became a Magical Girl. As Tama makes new friends and shares adventures with them, Paisley begins to feel as though she's being left behind. But is there more to this feeling than that?

[From [url=https://shibeyfacegames.itch.io/paisleys-heart-a-magical-girl-origin-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Paisley Clark生活在一个有梦魇、魔法少女等奇妙事物的世界，是个普通女孩。她最好的朋友Tama最近成为了魔法少女。随着Tama结识新朋友、与她们一同冒险，Paisley开始觉得自己似乎被抛在了后头。但这种感受背后，是否另有隐情？

[来源：[url=https://shibeyfacegames.itch.io/paisleys-heart-a-magical-girl-origin-story]Itch.io[/url]]
